title: Project Workspace Boundary
summary: Define project-scoped workspace membership, role assignment and resource isolation for the P0 Canonical Specification Core.

intent.statement: Ensure that every P0 specification and audit record belongs to one project and is accessible only to an authorised member of that project.
desired_outcomes: P0 roles are clear and auditable.

success_measures.name: Cross-project access denial
success_measures.measurement_method: Run each workspace API operation with a principal who lacks the required project membership.

problem.statement: Specifications and audit records cannot be governed safely unless they have a clear project ownership and authorisation boundary.
problem.current_state: The initial repository does not yet define a project membership domain model or access-control contract.
impact: Unauthorised disclosure or modification of engineering intent would undermine trust in AGASTYA.

business_context.business_value: Project isolation is a prerequisite for trusted multi-project use of the Specification Studio.

actors.name: Project Owner
goals: Manage project membership and approve specifications.

functional_requirements.title: Enforce project-scoped membership
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall allow a project Owner to grant Owner, Editor or Viewer membership to an identified user and shall evaluate that membership on every project-scoped operation.

non_functional_requirements.statement: The authorisation layer shall default-deny an operation when project membership or a required role is absent.
non_functional_requirements.verification_method: Automated negative authorisation tests for each role and cross-project request.

business_rules.statement: A Viewer may never create, alter, validate, approve or archive a specification revision.

bounded_contexts.name: Workspace Management
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Own project identity, membership and role grants.

ubiquitous_language.definition: The isolation boundary for specifications, audit events and memberships in P0.
A role grant that authorises a principal within one project.

security_requirements.statement: The service shall record an audit event for each membership change and each denied approval attempt.
security_requirements.verification_method: Integration tests assert that the corresponding immutable audit events are emitted.

acceptance_criteria.title: A Viewer is denied write access
acceptance_criteria.given: A Viewer belongs to a project with a draft specification.
acceptance_criteria.when: The Viewer requests a create, update, validate or approve operation.
acceptance_criteria.then: The system returns an authorisation denial, makes no state change and records a security audit event.

test_requirements.scope: Role matrix and cross-project authorisation for all P0 specification operations.
test_requirements.expected_evidence: Automated role-matrix test report plus immutable audit events.

open_questions.question: Should an Owner be able to transfer ownership when they are the only current Owner of a project?
open_questions.impact_if_unresolved: Membership API semantics and recovery behaviour remain incomplete.

coverage_summary.method: Draft specification; automated traceability coverage has not been calculated.

change_history.reason: Child specification required for P0 implementation planning.
